tagline: Deep bolsters all the way round, so there's always an edge to settle against.
lead: For the dog who sleeps pressed against the sofa or the wall: deep bolsters all round a plush middle.
value: At 110 × 75cm this is a genuinely large bed with a full surround, a non-slip base and a washable cover.
intro: Thrush is a large plush bolster dog bed, 110 × 75cm, with deep-filled bolsters around the whole edge, a soft plush sleeping surface, a non-slip base and a removable, machine-washable cover.
points: Deep-filled bolsters run right round, so whichever way they turn there's an edge.
A soft sleeping surface, soft-filled rather than foam, so it feels cosy rather than firm.
A non-slip base for wood, laminate and tiled floors.
The cover comes off for the washing machine.
best_for: Dogs who sleep with their back against something and like deep edges around a soft middle. If yours needs firm support, choose a foam bed.
fit_note: One size. It's the outside measurement and the bolsters take up part of it, so measure your dog curled up as well as stretched out. Unsure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Take the cover off and follow the sewn-in washing instructions. Let it air-dry fully before you put it back on.
seo_title: Large Plush Bolster Dog Bed, Non-Slip Base | Snoozly
seo_description: Deep bolsters all round a soft plush middle, for dogs who sleep pressed against an edge. Large 110 × 75cm bolster dog bed, non-slip base, washable cover.
